services.name: pontoon boat rentals
services.desc: Hontoon Landing Resort & Marina, on the world-famous St. Johns River, is your destination for pontoon boat rentals in DeLand, FL. Our resort is also the perfect spot for St. Johns River vacations, company retreats, fishing, or just exploring the river’s scenic sites. Our resort is conveniently located between Daytona Beach, Ocala, and Orlando, FL. The St. Johns River is one of the few major rivers in the world that flows due north, stretching 310 miles through the heart of Florida. Often called the "River of Lakes," this picturesque waterway is an American Heritage River, renowned for its slow current, rich history, and incredible bass fishing.
